336.note: The shipped instant viral modifier is fixed 14 with ValueFunction 0. The level-50 archive reports applied plus resisted totals of 260 and 280 on the same selected view 5/spawn 167. The first cast (marketplace 8232 to 8726) has Daze source 199 stat 172 −5, then the same record removes at 8739. The second (12203 to 12747) lands after a switch to Speed at 12675 with Daze absent. Both retain Hacker Style +46 stat 172. This identifies differing conditions without assigning the full difference to Daze. The disposable level-30 comparison independently verifies per-recipient resistance on the existing calibrated model: captured 336 hits the same QAFar edge before, during and after a normal Empty Mind +45 while the selected primary stays neutral. The relationship of the authored base to the archive totals and stock verification of this area remain open. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/859

area.source: GOB 336 is CastDirectObjects 3 with radius 3 m. Its level-50 stock request at actions_combat.log lines 13247–13248 supplies a selected view/spawn, and the archived relationship of the hit recipients leaves their exact positions open.
area.runtime: Eligible hostile recipients within 3 m of the selected target run their own viral contests. A missing or replaced primary cannot supply a centre. The existing capture-calibrated damage range is retained.
area.test: HackerArtilleristAreaMode uses that exact request with only the live view/spawn rebound, then takes real damage on the selected enemy and the 3.00 m edge. The 3.01 m character and nearby ally are unchanged. The original radius does not damage its bystander after its primary leaves selection range during the cast.

targeting.test: SelectedFieldUsesTheAdmittedLiveSpawnAndCannotSplashAfterInvalidation verifies the owned and blocked admission gates and stale in-flight target. The exact archival headless replay exercises ordinary Archive reload, no-target, ally, 16.01 m refusal and selected hits.

337.note: The shipped instant viral modifier is fixed 17 with ValueFunction 0. Nine archived level-50 caster records total 300 after the last visible Speed request within their file. Three more total 300 before the first visible tactic request in the second file. Four total 360 after Power. On the same selected Zombie Curse view 15/spawn 173, the marketplace Speed hit 22761 and Power hits 27773 and 40998 preserve that split. The active Daze on the first Power cast removes at 27654, before its hit. This is consistent with the shipped 1.2 multiplier on a shared pre-tactic subtotal. The chosen landing policy applies Power after viral influence and before victim mitigation. The disposable fixture sends the captured Power while the second 337 cast is in flight. Empty Mind protects the QAFar edge before natural expiry, while the unprotected selected target uses the powered subtotal. The relation of the authored 17 to the pre-tactic damage and native-family check remain open. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/859
